rules.breach: equity strictly below floor; permanent failure; challenge liquidation after observed breach; no reset

rules.margin: No resize; reject new entry when gross open + pending + proposed USD notional / 15 exceeds current equity. No additional percent buffer.

parity.meaning: Exact current-source mechanical input freeze, no complete productionEX5parity certification. Direct source excludes the shared margin admission wrapper; parity only meaningful if no risk-margin rejections.

limitations: Exness historical quotes/fees and broker contract model, not actual FTMO execution.
Native source-compiled namespaced adapter, not proof of byte-identical production EX5.
Secondary symbol latest-quote dispatch and FTMO equity observer are sampled at primary ticks plus one-second timer.
61-day retrospective path cannot estimate funded pass probability or future median pass days.
Existing module broker lot rounding is retained; nominal1% is not a maximum realized loss.
